about: The one owner of every tool row the README shows: its Tools and Developer tools tables and the tool map diagram. scripts/readme_figures.py writes them; status is a word of AGENTS.md's README Status values; map.sources lists each outside service group, one item per line, with the service adapter it enters through (via) when it has one; supernote names the runtime whose adapter reads the registry; registry names the registry tools whose items give the row's levels (#407, #412); network lists each service a plugin sends data to, which its release notes print, an empty list for none (#373). credits holds the README Credits section: the Supernote projects whose code Ink Tools uses or whose ideas it follows, in two groups; notCredited lists the general libraries and data a NOTICE.md links that stay out of it, so --check fails when a NOTICE.md links a repository in neither (#424).

sections.title: Tools
sections.intro: For people who use the tablet.

features.name: Smart Shapes
features.text: draw a triangle, circle, square, rectangle or arrow and hold the pen still at the end; it becomes a clean shape, and letters stay handwriting.

features.name: Real-Time Text
features.text: while it is on, each handwritten word becomes typed text at its place, with no lasso; drawings stay handwriting.

features.name: Undo Conversion
features.text: brings the last converted word back as handwriting.

features.name: Gestures
features.text: a finger double or triple tap picks a pen, the eraser or the lasso, as you map it.

tools.name: Lasso Actions
network: Wikimedia Commons and Wikidata: the word you look up, to find a picture
Openclipart: the word you look up, to find a drawing
GitHub: to download the word lists and emoji pictures it uses; nothing of yours is sent

features.name: Word Lookup
features.text: lasso a handwritten word, then Insert Sticker (a clean illustration), Insert Image (a photo), Choose Image (pick from the results), Insert Definition, Insert Summary (three sentences from Wikipedia) or Translate, one button per language pair, such as «Translate ES→PT».

features.name: Convert to Text
features.text: turn the whole lassoed handwriting into one text box.

features.name: Headings
features.text: Heading 1 to Heading 4 turn a lassoed line into a heading of that level at the left margin, across the page.

features.name: Collection
features.text: Add to Collection and Cut to Collection gather lasso selections; Paste Collection puts them together on another page.

features.name: Enhance
features.text: make a lassoed picture readable on e-ink with one tap; Lighter and Darker adjust it.

features.name: Crop
features.text: draw a rectangle with the pen around the part to keep.

features.name: Erase
features.text: draw over the part to erase with the pen.

features.name: Remove background
features.text: keep the subject and drop what is behind it.

features.name: Make sticker
features.text: turn the picture into a sticker.

features.name: Document
features.text: straighten a photographed page as a document.

tools.name: Device Link
network: LocalSend devices you pick on your own local network; nothing goes to the internet

features.name: Send Page
features.text: send the open page to an iPhone or a Mac over LocalSend.

features.name: Send Selection
features.text: send a lasso selection, as typed text or as a picture; you choose on each send.

features.name: Receive
features.text: receive text, a picture or a PDF into the open note.

features.name: Editor helper
features.text: applies the Ink Notebook Editor's edits from the Mac to the tablet's notes.

outside: on an iPhone or a Mac

logic: ink-core: page to PNG, receive and insert

tools.name: Account Sync
network: Google Calendar, only when you connect a Google account
Todoist, only when you connect a Todoist account
iCloud Calendar (CalDAV), only when you connect an Apple ID
Each calendar feed (ICS) address you add

features.name: To-Do
features.text: sync the tablet's to-dos with Todoist.

features.name: Calendar
features.text: sync Google, iCloud and ICS calendars with the tablet's calendar.

features.name: Digest
features.text: sync the Digest both ways with your Telegram «Saved Messages».

features.name: New game
features.text: pick a game, a language and a difficulty; the game is a new page after the current one, its grid drawn as the page background, so erasing never removes it.

features.name: Show solution
features.text: shows the answer over the plugin's view, never on the page.

features.name: Check
features.text: reads what you wrote and marks the wrong cells.

features.name: Switch Language
features.text: switch the handwriting recognition language of the whole tablet with one tap.

features.name: Floating button
features.text: a small button where you write, shown only while there is text or ink input.

features.name: Open a note
features.text: read a `.note` notebook on the Mac and page through it.

features.name: Open from Tablet
features.text: copy a note from the tablet over the cable through `inkctl` and open the copy.

features.name: Edit
features.text: edit a note on the Mac without breaking the format, and send the edits back through Device Link.

logic: NoteFormat: read and draw a note

features.name: Control
features.text: `inkctl` controls the tablet over Wi-Fi ADB or USB with direct calls, JSON answers and stable exit codes, without root.

features.name: Plugins
features.text: install, enable, permit and uninstall plugins with no screen.

features.name: Notes and ink
features.text: open notes, write synthetic ink, lasso and read the screen for tests.

features.name: Firmware watch
features.text: on connect, check every device dependency and report what a firmware update broke.

features.name: Plugin settings
features.text: lets `inkctl` install, enable and permit plugins with no screen.

features.name: Firmware watch
features.text: at boot after a firmware change, check every device dependency and report what broke.

features.name: Run Command
features.text: the sidebar button `inkctl` presses to write ink and lasso with no pen.

features.name: Probes
features.text: quick on-device experiments for our tests. Never shipped.

credits.intro: A special thank-you to the authors of these Supernote projects. Ink Tools stands on their work: some of their code runs inside it, and some of their ideas shaped it.
credits.closing: Each project's licence, and what Ink Tools took from it, is in the `NOTICE.md` of the part that uses it.
